source: Orszag (1971) JFM 50:689 Table 5: 32 least-stable Orr-Sommerfeld eigenvalues of plane Poiseuille flow, alpha=1, R=10000 (refPapers/NewPapers/figures/orszag1971_table5_least_stable_spectrum.png).
quantity: full temporal eigenvalue spectrum c = c_r + i*c_i (32 least-stable modes)
verdict_reason: Full OS spectrum. Our LST code reproduces ALL 32 of Orszag's tabulated eigenvalues to max abs err 7.2e-06 (median 5.2e-08); 32/32 match to < 1e-5. The dense eigensolver resolves the A-branch (c_r~0.96), P-branch (c_r~0.2-0.5) and S-branch, including the near-degenerate symmetric/antisymmetric pairs that differ only in the 5th-6th digit (modes 2&3 at 0.96463 vs 0.96464). This upgrades the Orszag validation from a single eigenvalue (Table 2) to the full branch structure. Mirror of validation/test_orszag_full_spectrum.py.
pymack_provenance: Chebyshev-tau OS operator (pymack.spectral chebyshev_D) on plane Poiseuille [-1,1], N=128, dense scipy.linalg.eig; same setup as validation/test_orr_sommerfeld.py.
